zh.name: 模特上身与街拍展示
zh.summary: 用街拍和室内上身图展示同款轮廓。
zh.useWhen: 适合潮牌上新、街头风穿搭和同款多场景展示。
zh.instructions: 上传同款上身照和服装细节，填写卖点。
zh.output: 街拍封面、卖点页和多场景穿搭图。

en.name: Streetwear Try-on and Street Scenes
en.summary: Turn your product photos into a TikTok Shop carousel about streetwear Try-on and Street Scenes.
en.useWhen: For streetwear launches and outfits worn in several settings.
en.instructions: Upload product and reference photos, then add verified details.
en.output: An editable TikTok Shop carousel with streetwear Try-on and Street Scenes.
